<infobox theme="astro">
	<image source="image"></image>
    <title source="name"></title>
	<navigation name="mobile-eras"><center>{{Top-mobile}}</center></navigation>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Historical information</header>
        <data source="founded"><label>Date founded</label></data>	
        <data source="founders"><label>Founded by</label></data>
        <data source="dissolved"><label>Date dissolved</label></data>
        <data source="eras"><label>Era(s)</label></data>	
	</group>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Astrographical information</header>
        <data source="regions"><label>Regions</label></data>	
        <data source="sectors"><label>Sectors</label></data>
        <data source="stellar"><label>Stellar bodies</label></data>
        <data source="endpoints"><label>End points</label></data>				
        <data source="transitpoints"><label>Transit points</label></data>
        <data source="otherobjects"><label>Other objects</label></data>
        <data source="junctions"><label>Junctions</label></data>	
    </group>
    <navigation><small>{{PlainLink|//starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Template:TradeRoute|name=<nowiki>[</nowiki>Source<nowiki>]</nowiki>}}</small></navigation>
</infobox>{{PreloadCat}}{{#invoke:InfoboxParamCheck|main|image|name|founded|founders|dissolved|eras|regions|sectors|stellar|endpoints|transitpoints|otherobjects|junctions}}<noinclude>[[Category:Astrographical infobox templates]]{{clear}}
==Usage instructions==
Copy and paste the following code into the top of the article, filling the appropriate fields. Omitted or blank fields will not be shown on the article page.
<pre><nowiki>{{TradeRoute
|image=
|name=
|founded=
|founders=
|dissolved=
|eras=
|regions=
|sectors=
|stellar=
|endpoints=
|transitpoints=
|otherobjects=
|junctions=
}}
</nowiki></pre>

'''Note:''' Per [[Forum:SH:Trade route infobox tweaks]], |endpoints= should be listed alphabetically. And only the highest level transit points get listed via infobox.</noinclude>
